.. change::
    :tags: change, sqlite
    :tickets: 13433

    Added deprecation warnings for two SQLite ``:memory:`` URI patterns
    where the ``mode`` query string parameter is used to influence pool
    selection in a way that isn't fully sound: using ``mode`` without
    also passing ``uri=true``, and using ``mode=memory`` without
    ``cache=shared``. In both cases the automatic pool selection behavior
    that keys off of ``mode`` is planned to be removed in a future
    release; a plain ``:memory:`` database, or an explicit ``poolclass``,
    should be used instead. This is the first phase of a deprecation
    described in the issue; the pool-selection behavior itself is
    unchanged in this release.
